title: Dominic and the Inventory
author: Jude Oyelaran
blurb: Ivo Amberdale, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
